name: 06516 · West Haven, CT
findings: ZIP 06516 (West Haven) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06516 (West Haven) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
